Sun, Apr 26, 11:57 AM (1 day ago)
to me, Eric, Aanchal

Hey Bethany & Eric,

Just circling back on the SEO proposal from last week. I know things have been a lot on your end with the studio setup, sales calls coming in, and everything else!

Quick recap of what we went over:
5 cornerstone SEO posts (med spa marketing, operations, revenue growth, consultant, business coach), built at root-level URLs to rank as core pillars of the site
3 location-specific landing pages, pulling double duty for organic SEO and as dedicated geo-targeted ad landing pages
10% returning client discount → $3,195 total
~3 week turnaround once we kick off
Full proposal here.

To make this easier on your end, I'm happy to draft 2-3 angle options for each of the cornerstone posts so you don't have to come up with topics from scratch. You'd just review and pick the direction you like best.

Let me know if you guys would like to get started and I'll send over an invoice.

:::writing{variant="email" id="58291" subject="Re: SEO Proposal"}
Hi Ashley,

I’m so sorry for this slipping through the cracks on our end today, I appreciate you following up.

Yes, we are definitely interested. This aligns well with where we’re heading. We are in the middle of onboarding several new clients this week and want to make sure we give this the proper attention it deserves.

Can we circle back toward the end of this week once things settle a bit on our side? That way we can review everything more thoroughly and move forward intentionally.

Appreciate you making this easy for us and offering to draft angles as well, that’s super helpful.

Talk soon,  
Bethany
:::
